user.title: Log in to REMA 1000
user.description: Use the same e-mail and password as on rema1000.dk and in the REMA 1000 app. Items are always added to your primary shopping list, the one shown in the app.

reauth_confirm.description: The login for {email} no longer works. Enter the current password.

data_description.password: The current password for the REMA 1000 account.

reconfigure.title: Change REMA 1000 login
reconfigure.description: Change the e-mail or password used for this REMA 1000 account. It must be the same account; to use another account, add the integration again.

data_description.email: The e-mail you log in to rema1000.dk and the REMA 1000 app with.
data_description.password: The current password for the REMA 1000 account.

migrate.title: Move your REMA 1000 setup
migrate.description: There is a setup of the old REMA 1000 integration for {account}. Submit to move it to Middagsro with its meal plans, settings, recipe collection and entities (they keep their IDs). You don't have to log in again.

no_ai_task.title: No AI Task for Middagsro
no_ai_task.description:
Middagsro makes meal plans with an AI Task entity, but none was found.

Set up an AI service that offers AI Tasks, for example Google Generative AI, OpenAI or Ollama (Settings → Devices & services → Add integration). Then choose it under Settings in the Middagsro panel, or set a preferred AI Task in Home Assistant.

This message goes away by itself the next time a meal plan is made.
